QuestInfo.name: Cygnus the Betrayer
QuestInfo.0: You can't figure why the people of #m310000000# hate the #p1101000# Knights so much... Since you've come to Ereve, ask the #bEmpress#k.
QuestInfo.1: When you ask Empress #p1101000# about #m310000000#, she grimaces and says it's because the Knights have broken their promise to the town. You still don't know what happened between the Cygnus Knights and the residents of Edelstein... Ask #b#p1101002##k.
QuestInfo.2:
#m310000000# is a town taken over by the Black Wings. Apparently, the people of #m310000000# formed the Resistance and fought against the Black Wings for years in order to drive them out of their town. Empress #p1101000# had her Knights join forces with the Resistance in order to stop the revival of the Black Mage.

One day, the Resistance decided to launch their ultimate attack and asked the Knights to help them. Without hesitation, the Empress willingly agreed to provide support.  However, the Cygnus Knights broke their promise and #m310000000# was defeated, resulting in more severe oppression and surveillance of its residents. 

Since then, the townspeople have despised the Empress and her Knights as much as they do the Black Wings.

0.0: #h0#... What a delight to see you. It has been a long time. Since #p1101002# handles most of the administrative work, I rarely have a chance to meet with individual Knights. \r\n#L0##bWhat happened in #m310000000#? The people there seem angry with us. They say that we betrayed them.#l\n#k
0.1: #m310000000#! Ah. Yes, that burden has been heavy on my soul. They are correct. We--no, I wronged them. Horribly. I betrayed them by breaking a very important promise. It is completely my fault.\r\n#L0##bWhat kind of promise? Why didn't you keep your word?#l\n#k
0.2: It is something that I cannot undo. I will not make any excuses for my actions. All I can do is live with my guilt. I'm sorry that my actions have inconvenienced you, but whatever you do, do not bring more harm upon the people of #m310000000#.

yes.0: #b(Empress #p1101000# lowers her face, a sad expression on her face. You probably shouldn't probe any deeper. Maybe #p1101002# will know more about this.)#k

1.0: Hmm? Aren't you in the middle of a mission? What are you doing in Ereve? What? What do I know about #m310000000#? Ah, I guess time has come for you to find out about our troubled relationship with them. The relationship that the #p1101000# Knights betrayed...

yes.0: As I'm sure you already know, #m310000000# is under the rule of the Black Wings. The evil Black Wings, in their attempt to resurrect the Black Mage, have occupied an innocent city and are robbing them of both their resources and their freedom.
yes.1: The residents of #m310000000# fought back fiercely. When we found out about their Resistance, we decided to join forces with them. We were united by a common enemy.
yes.2: Time passed and the people of #m310000000# prepared for battle. They devised a plan to defeat the Black Wings and regain their freedom once and for all. We swore to help them. On the day of the battle, the #p110100# knights were to send support troops.
yes.3: But of all days, on THAT day... No, don't ask anymore. Something happened, which we didn't expect, something we were powerless against. We weren't able to help the people of #m310000000#. We were barely able to defend ourselves.
yes.4: In the end, we barely managed to protect Ereve and the Empress, but #m310000000# was a complete disaster. The Black Wings came down upon them hard, all because we weren't there to help them...
yes.5: So you see, their anger is justified. We must accept their condemnation. You are responsible. Yes, you. Though you weren't directly responsible, you are a #p1101000# Knight, so you must shoulder part of the blame.
yes.6: As the Empress has said, if there is anything you can do for them, please do it. They have sworn to have nothing to do with anything that bears the name of the Empress so... there is very little we as an organization can do.

npc.0: The only thing I can say about #m310000000# is that I'm sorry... So very sorry...
